# T-4: Delegate registry lifecycle

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Update registry.js hooks so lifecycle decisions are applied through definition-side lifecycle resolution instead of registry-local hardcoded maps and step ids.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Review runtime step resolution is delegated to definition-side lifecycle or runtime-step APIs.
- Draft review PASS lifecycle writes or invokes existing empty draft triage/repair artifact generation before draft-gate validation.
- Proposal-producing implementation review lifecycle resets rebuildable evidence and downstream leaves from test-execute through finalize-cleanup while keeping impl-review open.
- Gate step resolution used by registry hooks is delegated to definition-side APIs.
- Finalize downstream skip/reset decisions are derived from definition-side lifecycle rules.
- Registry command entries still contain command metadata, args, help, requirements, and hook connection points.

## Implementation Notes
Preserve registry.js as the command registry. Shared lifecycle application helpers may live outside registry.js if that keeps registry entries thin.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests assert registry.js no longer contains the old phase maps/downstream leaf lists, draft PASS artifact generation is preserved, implementation-review proposal evidence reset is preserved, and representative lifecycle transitions still update steps as expected.
